title.en: Had it not been for the rain
title.es: De no haber sido por la lluvia

es: Reconocer contrafactuales con inversión (had it not been for, had we known) y su equivalente con if.

teaching.en: Had it not been for our captain, we would never have won the league.
teaching.es: De no haber sido por nuestra capitana, nunca habríamos ganado la liga.
teaching.explanationEs: Had it not been for + nombre equivale a If it hadn't been for: desaparece if y had pasa delante.
segments: Had it not been for our captain,
we would never have won the league.
teaching.audioText: Had it not been for our captain, we would never have won the league.

teaching.en: Had the supporters known about the storm, they would have stayed at home.
teaching.es: De haber sabido los aficionados lo de la tormenta, se habrían quedado en casa.
teaching.explanationEs: Had + sujeto + participio sustituye a If + sujeto + had + participio.
segments: Had the supporters known about the storm,
they would have stayed at home.
teaching.audioText: Had the supporters known about the storm, they would have stayed at home.

teaching.en: Had the referee not blown the whistle, the penalty would never have been given.
teaching.es: Si el árbitro no hubiera pitado, nunca se habría señalado el penalti.
teaching.explanationEs: En la negación, not va después del sujeto: Had the referee not blown (no se dice hadn't the referee).
segments: Had the referee not blown the whistle,
the penalty would never have been given.
teaching.audioText: Had the referee not blown the whistle, the penalty would never have been given.

teaching.en: If he hadn't missed that penalty, the defeat would never have happened.
teaching.es: Si no hubiera fallado ese penalti, la derrota nunca habría ocurrido.
teaching.explanationEs: La versión con if es la normal al hablar; la inversión suena más formal y se usa en crónicas y textos escritos.
segments: If he hadn't missed that penalty,
the defeat would never have happened.
teaching.audioText: If he hadn't missed that penalty, the defeat would never have happened.

teaching.en: The team would have lifted the trophy had the weather been better.
teaching.es: El equipo habría levantado el trofeo si el tiempo hubiera sido mejor.
teaching.explanationEs: La cláusula con had también puede ir al final, sin coma.
segments: The team would have lifted the
trophy had the weather been better.
teaching.audioText: The team would have lifted the trophy had the weather been better.

prompt.es: Completa: «De no haber sido por nuestro capitán, habríamos perdido.»

feedback.es: La inversión con had sustituye a If it hadn't been for y abre la frase.

hint.es: Sustituye a «if it hadn't» y abre la cláusula.

feedback.es: Had + sujeto + participio forma la cláusula; la consecuencia va después con would have.

hint.es: Empieza con el auxiliar y el sujeto; la consecuencia va al final.

prompt.es: Elige la versión con inversión de la frase del texto.

choices.text: If had they trained harder, they would have won the league.
Had they trained harder, they would win the league.
Had they trained harder, they would have won the league.

feedback.es: La inversión elimina if y mantiene would have + participio; con would win la consecuencia deja de ser pasada.

hint.es: Quita if, pon had delante del sujeto y conserva la consecuencia en pasado.

origin.text: If they had trained harder, they would have won the league.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pasó de verdad con el portero.

choices.text: He was injured, so the coach changed the team.

feedback.es: Had he not been injured implica que sí estaba lesionado: por eso el entrenador cambió el equipo.

origin.audio: Had the goalkeeper not been injured, the coach would have kept the same team for the final.

choices.text: I wish I had studied more.
I wish I would study more.
